spans.s:
m. (-ष्ट्रः)
1 A camel.
2 A cart, a vehicle of burthen.
f. (-ष्ट्री or -ष्ट्रिका)
An earthen vessel.
2 A she camel.
E.
उष to burn, and ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi affix, fem. ङीष्, or ठाप् with इक् inserted.

f. (-ण्डी)
A flower of a red colour.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Making a noise like a camel.
E.
उष्ट्र and क्रुश to cry, णिनि aff.

n. (-गं)
A pair of camels.
E.
उष्ट्र and गोयुग a couple.

m. (-वः)
Hemorrhoids.
E.
उष्ट्र and ग्रीवा the neck.

f. (-का)
Arabian jasmin.
E.
उष्ट्र and पाद a foot: from the shape of its flowers.

n. (-नं)
A camel litter, a vehicle drawn or borne by camels.
E.
उष्ट्र and यान a carriage.

m. (-रः)
Piles, hemorrhoids, bleeding piles.
E.
उष्ट्र a camel, शिरस् head, and धर what has.
